name: slack-summary-reporter
title: Slack Summary Reporter
description: Fetches recent Slack messages, summarizes them via OpenAI, and posts back to Slack.

summaryDays.title: How many days back to fetch messages
summaryDays.description: Number of days of Slack history to include in the summary

maxChunkTokens.title: Max Chunk Tokens
maxChunkTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens per chunk when sending to OpenAI

slackTokenFetch.title: Slack Token (read)
slackTokenFetch.description: Bot or user token with conversations.history scope

slackChannelFetch.title: Slack Channel ID (read)
slackChannelFetch.description: ID of the channel to fetch messages from (e.g. C0123456789)

slackTokenPost.title: Slack Token (post)
slackTokenPost.description: Bot or user token with chat:write scope

slackChannelPost.title: Slack Channel ID (post)
slackChannelPost.description: ID of the channel to post the summary to (e.g. C9876543210)
